verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe several in-product AI features built on incident data. These include AI-generated incident summaries created at declaration and tailored by audience, AI-drafted retrospectives with timelines, impacts and preliminary lessons learned, and a Copilot that compares ongoing incidents with past ones and makes suggestions in Command Center and Slack. AI also captures Zoom chat and meeting insights, with tenant-level control over which AI features are enabled. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of AI output quality, and AI-driven insights over aggregate analytics or trend data (the analytics evidence describes only conventional filtering and grouping).
